title: heart rate AND SpO2 alarm
task: Two sensors on two ports: abnormal heart rate AND desaturation -> confirmed alarm, which suppresses single-sensor false alarms.
signal: windows from the heart-rate and SpO2 generators above, paired by index; the ground truth is both events present (independent draws, so about a quarter of the windows).
model_size: heads: intnn binary 8 -> 8 -> 1 (heart rate) and intnn 4-bit 6 -> 8 -> 1 (SpO2)
data: Synthetic data from a seeded generator, not patient data; the detection figures are on synthetic test windows and make no clinical claim.
